name: 3D Aquarium Nausicaä Centre National..
summary: The Nausicaä Centre National de la Mer Aquarium in France is the largest aquarium in Europe. It is located on the Boulogne sur Mer in the north-east of France. From Paris it takes about 1 hour by train. The video shows impressive underwater shots in 3D - ideal for the Meta Quest. You can use the controller buttons X, Y and A, B to switch the view from 3D to 2D. You are in a 3D environment and see the 3D video on a curved screen.
